viewing_check: Estimate 40-60, current bid $10 (+22% premium). Best match, a didgeridoo with clap sticks, sold A$30.60 (Apr 2024). Painted souvenir didgeridoos sold about A$30-50, signed playable ones A$95+. Andy should check for an artist signature or certificate on the underside/inside, any cracks, and whether the sticks have a label naming an artist. Prices fairly flat 2023-2026. Postage of a 1.2 m tube is costly.
